title: Motorcyclist hurt in crash on McPherson Road at International Boulevard
excerpt: A motorcyclist was hurt in a crash Sunday, November 1, around 7:45 p.m. at McPherson Road at International Boulevard in Laredo, according to KGNS.
content:
A motorcyclist was hurt in a crash Sunday, November 1, around 7:45 p.m. at McPherson Road at International Boulevard in Laredo, according to KGNS.

The man was wearing a helmet and reported arm pain, KGNS reported. One southbound lane was blocked off while police worked the scene, and delays were expected, according to KGNS.

The reporting reviewed did not state the man's name or age, the cause of the crash, any other vehicle involved, or whether anyone else was injured.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Motorcyclist hurt in crash on McPherson Road," November 1, 2026
